title: Row banding
description: Reduces faint stripes caused by uneven sensor rows. Usually best left on. This does not smooth general grain. The Banding noise slider is a separate correction.
note: Shadow crop at Exposure +3 EV. Noise and Detail is off. The stripes look vertical because the photo is rotated.

variants.label: Off
variants.caption: Faint stripes run through the blue shadow.

variants.label: On
variants.caption: The stripes are reduced. The grain remains.
